post.linkedin_text:
Most reels for business lose people in the first second. And usually it's the hook, not the video.

So here's a simple way to write reel hooks for business that you can try this week.

Why it matters: people decide very fast whether to keep watching. If the opening doesn't tell them why this is for them, they scroll. Even if the rest of the reel is good.

Here's the formula I'd use:

1. Start with who it's for. "If you run a clinic in Chennai..." Now the right people stop.
2. Name one problem or want. "...and your weekends are slow..."
3. Promise a payoff. "...try this one thing."
4. Put the hook on screen as text too, because a lot of people watch without sound.
5. Write 5 hooks before you shoot. Then pick the clearest one, not the cleverest.

A simple example for a bakery in T. Nagar:
Instead of "Welcome to our bakery!" try "Ordering a birthday cake in T. Nagar? Watch this before you book."

Same video. Very different first second.

That's really all good reel hooks for business need: the right person, one problem, one reason to stay. Swipe through the 5 steps 👇

This is the kind of thing we do for clients at Loyara.

Which step do you usually skip: 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5?

linkedin_carousel.title: Reel Hooks for Business: 5 Simple Steps

slides.heading: Start with who it's for
slides.body: Open by naming your customer. "If you run a clinic in Chennai..." The right people stop scrolling because they know it's for them.

slides.heading: Name one problem or want
slides.body: Just one. "...and your weekends are slow." A clear problem keeps people watching more than a list of features.

slides.heading: Promise a payoff
slides.body: Tell them what they get if they stay. "Try this one thing." Now they have a reason to watch till the end.

slides.heading: Put the hook on screen too
slides.body: A lot of people watch without sound. So show the hook as big text in the first frame, not only in your voice.

slides.heading: Write 5 hooks first
slides.body: Then pick the clearest, not the cleverest. Like: "Ordering a birthday cake in T. Nagar? Watch this before you book."
